verdict.rationale: Skyvern's debugging docs say every run automatically captures a browser session recording, per-step screenshots, the AI's reasoning and network traffic. A dedicated guide covers diagnosing failed runs from their status, failure category, recording and logs. A community user separately praises the observability of workflow steps. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented step-by-step action timeline view (only implied by per-step screenshots and reasoning), and hands-on corroboration of replaying a failed run specifically.
